narrative: Material PL1__M0506790 exhibits erratic demand (CV=0.77) with variable lead times (CV=0.49). The current SAP policy uses excessive ordering frequency (955 orders/year) with insufficient safety stock (610 units). Optimizing to EOQ-based ordering (3535 units every 9 days) with adequate safety buffers (1244 units) will reduce total annual costs by $66273 (91.4%), primarily by reducing ordering costs from $71649 to $2311.
warnings: Recommended safety stock (1244) is 2.0x higher than SAP (610)
High demand variability (CV=0.77) increases risk; consider demand forecasting improvements
